conventions.testing: Unit tests in mod tests blocks with semantic extractor integration tests
conventions.linting: clippy with deny-level rules for undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used
conventions.error_handling: Option/Result patterns, expect() for critical initialization

patterns: LanguageInfo struct with optional query fields and handler functions
Per-language module with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY constants
extract_inheritance handler walks inheritance_specifier -> inherits_from -> type_identifier
constraints: DEFUSE_QUERY is mandatory - LanguageInfo.defuse_query field must be set for all languages
No feature flags - all languages unconditionally compiled in per lang.rs comments
tree-sitter-swift 0.7.3 depends on tree-sitter-language ^0.1.0, no tree-sitter conflict
test_coverage: Each language module has unit tests for extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, element_query compilation, extract_inheritance, and defuse_query integration via SemanticExtractor

library_findings.notes: alex-pinkus/tree-sitter-swift; class_declaration covers class/struct/actor/enum/extension via declaration_kind field
workspace dependency; tree-sitter-swift uses tree-sitter-language abstraction

approaches.name: Follow Java pattern exactly
approaches.description: Create swift.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, and extract_inheritance modeled after java.rs. Register in mod.rs and lang.rs following CSS pattern.

approaches.name: Leverage declaration_kind field
approaches.description: Use class_declaration's declaration_kind field to distinguish class/struct/actor/enum/extension at runtime rather than separate node types.
pros: Single query pattern covers all types

recommendation: Follow Java pattern exactly while leveraging declaration_kind field. This combines the proven structure of java.rs with Swift's grammar design where class_declaration covers all declaration kinds.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
inheritance_walk_citation: Walk inheritance_specifier descendants; for each, read the inherits_from field, then find the type_identifier or user_type text to get the name. Multiple specifiers are siblings under _inheritance_specifiers.
